description_en: Queries the basic information of a MaxCompute project
name: GetProject

parameters.help_en: Whether to include additional information (securityProperties, superAdmins)
parameters.help_zh: 是否带有附加信息(securityProperties, superAdmins)
parameters.name: verbose

costStorage.description_en:
The total storage size.
Views the current storage size of the project. This storage size is consistent with the metering caliber, which is the logical storage size after compression at the Project level
costStorage.description_zh:
存储总量。
查看项目当前存储大小，此存储量与计量口径一致，即按Project采集压缩后的逻辑存储大小

defaultQuota.description_en:
The default computing quota.
Used to allocate computing resources. If no computing quota is specified, jobs initiated by this project will consume resources from the default quota. For more information about computing resource usage, see <props="china">Computing Resources - Quota Usage (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/use-of-computing-resources)</props>
<props="intl">Computing Resources - Quota Usage (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/use-of-computing-resources)</props>
defaultQuota.description_zh:
默认计算Quota。
用于实现计算资源分配。不指定计算Quota的情况下，该项目发起的作业将消耗默认Quota资源。更多计算资源使用请参见<props="china">计算资源-Quota使用 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/use-of-computing-resources)</props>
<props="intl">计算资源-Quota使用 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/use-of-computing-resources)</props>

ipList.description_en:
The IP whitelist for public network and cloud product interconnection network.

If only the public network and cloud product interconnection network IP whitelist is configured, access through the public network and cloud product interconnection network is restricted by the configuration, and all VPC network access is prohibited
ipList.description_zh:
公网和云产品互联网络IP白名单。

如果只配置公网和云产品互联网络IP白名单，则公网和云产品互联网络访问受配置限制，VPC网络访问全部禁止

vpcIpList.description_en:
The VPC network IP whitelist.
If only the VPC network IP whitelist is configured, VPC network access is restricted by the configuration, and all public network and cloud product interconnection network access is prohibited
vpcIpList.description_zh:
VPC网络IP白名单。
如果只配置VPC网络IP白名单，则VPC网络访问受配置限制，公网和云产品互联网络访问全部禁止

owner.description_en: The account information of the project owner

productType.description_en: The billing mode of the default computing quota

properties.description_en: The basic properties of the project

enableDecimal2.description_en: Whether the MaxCompute 2.0 Decimal data type is enabled for the project

enableFdcCacheForce.description_en: Whether to force enable external table caching

true: Data Transfer Service tasks submitted by this project will use the bound Data Transfer Service resource group by default.
false: Data Transfer Service tasks submitted by this project will use the Data Transfer Service shared resource group by default

algorithm.description_en: The data encryption algorithm. Supported encryption algorithms include AES256, AESCTR, and RC4
algorithm.description_zh: 数据加密算法：密钥支持的加密算法，包含AES256、AESCTR和RC4

enable.description_en:
Whether data encryption is enabled for the project. For more information about data encryption, see
<props="china">Storage Encryption (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/security-and-compliance/storage-encryption)</props>
<props="intl">Storage Encryption (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/security-and-compliance/storage-encryption)</props>

isExternalCatalogBound.description_en:

<props="intl">Lakehouse 2.0 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/lake-warehouse-integrated-2-0-use-guide)</props> external project
isExternalCatalogBound.description_zh:

retentionDays.description_en:
The number of days to retain backup data. During this period, you can restore the current version to any backed-up data version.
Valid values: [0, 30]. Default value: 1. A value of 0 indicates that the backup feature is disabled
retentionDays.description_zh:
备份数据的保留天数。在此期间，您可以将当前版本恢复至任意一个备份的数据版本。
取值范围为[0,30]，默认值为1，0代表关闭备份功能

sqlMeteringMax.description_en:
The maximum threshold for single SQL consumption.
Unit: scan volume (GB) × complexity
sqlMeteringMax.description_zh:
单SQL消费的最高阈值。
单位：扫描量（GB）*复杂度

type.description_en:
The lifecycle type. Valid values:
mandatory: The Lifecycle clause is mandatory. Users must set the table lifecycle.
optional: The Lifecycle clause is optional when creating a table. If the table lifecycle is not set, the table is permanently valid.
inherit: If the table lifecycle is not set when creating a table, the table lifecycle defaults to the value of odps.table.lifecycle.value
type.description_zh:
生命周期类型。取值：
mandatory：Lifecycle子句为必选设置，用户必须设置表的生命周期。
optional：创建表时，Lifecycle子句为可选设置，如果不设置表的生命周期，则该表永远有效。
inherit：创建表时，如果不设置表的生命周期，则该表的生命周期为odps.table.lifecycle.value的值

value.description_en: The table lifecycle in days. Valid values: 1 to 37231. Default value: 37231
value.description_zh: 表的生命周期，单位为：天。取值范围为1~37231，默认值为37231

tableLifecycleConfig.description_en:
The <props="china">tiered storage lifecycle rules (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tiered-storage#f61fc9db76nna)</props>
<props="intl">tiered storage lifecycle rules (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tiered-storage#f61fc9db76nna)</props> properties. After configuration, the system will trigger automatic storage tier conversion based on these rules
tableLifecycleConfig.description_zh:
<props="china">分层存储生命周期规则 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tiered-storage#f61fc9db76nna)</props>
<props="intl">分层存储生命周期规则 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/tiered-storage#f61fc9db76nna)</props>属性，设置后系统将基于该规则触发分层存储类型自动转换

DaysAfterLastAccessGreaterThan.description_en:
The number of days after the last data access before automatic conversion, corresponding to the `LastAccessTime` of the table or partition.

If the LastAccessTime of the table or partition is empty:
For tables or partitions created before October 1, 2023, the default time is 2023.10.01 00:00:00 in the UTC+0 timezone.
For tables or partitions created after October 1, 2023, if the data has not been accessed, the CreateTime is used for calculation
DaysAfterLastAccessGreaterThan.description_zh:
距离数据最后访问时间超过多少天后自动设置，对应表或分区的`LastAccessTime`。

若表或分区的LastAccessTime为空，则：
对于2023年10月01日前创建的表或分区，默认按照UTC+0时区的2023.10.01 00:00:00时间计算。
对于2023年10月01日后新建的表或分区，若数据没被访问过，按照CreateTime时间计算

DaysAfterLastModificationGreaterThan.description_en: The number of days after the last data modification before automatic conversion, corresponding to the `LastModifiedTime` of the table or partition
DaysAfterLastModificationGreaterThan.description_zh: 距离数据最后修改时间超过多少天后自动设置，对应表或分区的`LastModifiedTime`

DaysAfterLastTierModificationGreaterThan.description_en: The number of days since the last storage tier conversion
DaysAfterLastTierModificationGreaterThan.description_zh: 距离上次转换存储类型的时间

DaysAfterLastAccessGreaterThan.description_en:
The number of days after the last data access before automatic conversion, corresponding to the `LastAccessTime` of the table or partition.

If the LastAccessTime of the table or partition is empty:
For tables or partitions created before October 1, 2023, the default time is 2023.10.01 00:00:00 in the UTC+0 timezone.
For tables or partitions created after October 1, 2023, if the data has not been accessed, the CreateTime is used for calculation
DaysAfterLastAccessGreaterThan.description_zh:
定义距离数据最后访问时间超过多少天后自动设置，对应表或分区的`LastAccessTime`。

若表或分区的LastAccessTime为空，则：
对于2023年10月01日前创建的表或分区，默认按照UTC+0时区的2023.10.01 00:00:00时间计算。
对于2023年10月01日后新建的表或分区，若数据没被访问过，按照CreateTime时间计算

DaysAfterLastModificationGreaterThan.description_en: The number of days after the last data modification before automatic conversion, corresponding to the `LastModifiedTime` of the table or partition
DaysAfterLastModificationGreaterThan.description_zh: 定义距离数据最后修改时间超过多少天后自动设置，对应表或分区的`LastModifiedTime`

DaysAfterLastTierModificationGreaterThan.description_en: The number of days since the last storage tier conversion
DaysAfterLastTierModificationGreaterThan.description_zh: 距离上次转换存储类型的时间

tunnelQuota.description_en:
The <props="china">Data Transfer Service (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/overview-of-dts)</props>
<props="intl">Data Transfer Service (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/maxcompute/user-guide/overview-of-dts)</props> resource group bound to the project.

Default (Data Transfer Service shared resource group): This project is not allowed to use the Data Transfer Service (subscription) resource group. MaxCompute supports Schema, which is an object between Project and Table/Resource/UDF for categorizing Tables, Resources, and UDFs. A Project can contain multiple Schemas. httpCode.description_en:
The HTTP status code.
1xx: Informational response - The request has been received and is being processed.
2xx: Success - The request has been successfully received, understood, and accepted by the server.
3xx: Redirection - The request has been redirected. Further action is required to complete the request.
4xx: Client error - The request contains incorrect parameters, syntax errors, or specific request conditions cannot be met.
5xx: Server error - The server is unable to fulfill the request due to other reasons
httpCode.description_zh:
HTTP状态码。
1xx：信息响应 - 请求已接收，正在处理中。
2xx：成功 - 请求动作已被服务端成功接收、理解并接受。
3xx：重定向 - 请求被重定向，采取进一步行动以完成请求。
4xx：客户端错误 - 请求包含错误请求参、语法或特定请求条件无法满足。
5xx：服务端错误 - 服务器由于其他原因无法满足请求
